description:
The University of Canada West is located in Vancouver, one of Canada's most beautiful cities. Vancouver is one of the most livable cities in the world with its climate and living conditions.

Established in 2004, University of Canada West was first accepted by the Ministry on the recommendation of the "Degree Quality Assessment Board", which evaluates and approves the program quality of educational institutions. Offering undergraduate and graduate education, the university also offers English language programs for students of all levels. Approximately 62% of the university consists of students from 46 different countries of the world.

The University of Canada West campus is located in a central location on the main route of public transportation, which can be considered very close to the city center.

Quality teaching is at the core of UCW's principles. The announcement of the Center of Excellence in Teaching proves this situation. CTE will work with academic staff to support their knowledge, skills and expertise with creativity, innovative and research-based educational and technological approaches.

University Canada West professors have years of industry experience as well as respected academics. By transferring their own experiences to their classes, they instill in their students the knowledge and trends they need to be successful in the modern and global business world.
